audit_metadata.scope: 10 npm projects (Source/, platform/, portal/, demo directories)

critical_findings.title: Handlebars.js - Multiple JavaScript Injection Vulnerabilities
critical_findings.description: 8 distinct AST/template injection vulnerabilities allow arbitrary JavaScript execution

critical_findings.title: Vitest - Arbitrary File Read & Code Execution
critical_findings.description: UI server allows unauthenticated arbitrary file read/execution; @vitest/mocker allows path traversal
critical_findings.impact: Local network attacker can read .env files, source code, execute arbitrary code
critical_findings.fix: npm update vitest to >=5.0.1; disable --ui in CI/shared environments

critical_findings.title: Protobufjs - Prototype Pollution & DoS
critical_findings.description: Prototype pollution in untrusted protobuf deserialization; ReDoS in parsing
critical_findings.impact: Code execution via Object.prototype pollution; service crash
critical_findings.fix: npm update protobufjs to latest stable (>=7.4.0 if available)

high_findings.title: @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node - Prometheus Exporter Crash
high_findings.description: Malformed HTTP request to /metrics endpoint crashes Prometheus exporter

high_findings.title: brace-expansion - Multiple DoS Vulnerabilities
high_findings.description: 4 separate DoS vectors: memory exhaustion, exponential expansion, unbounded arrays

high_findings.title: browserslist - Memory Exhaustion & Prototype Pollution
high_findings.description: Unbounded memory growth (no cache eviction); prototype pollution via stats.json

high_findings.title: PostCSS - Arbitrary File Read via sourceMappingURL
high_findings.description: 4 distinct file read/traversal vulnerabilities; .env and source map leakage

high_findings.title: Vite - Path Traversal & fs.deny Bypass
high_findings.description: Windows UNC path bypass of fs.deny; path traversal in .map handling

high_findings.title: form-data - CRLF Injection in Multipart Fields
high_findings.description: Newline injection in field names/filenames; HTTP header injection possible

high_findings.title: @grpc/grpc-js - Malformed Request Crash (DoS)
high_findings.description: Network attacker can crash gRPC services with malformed/compressed messages

high_findings.title: nanoid - Integer Overflow & Infinite Loop
high_findings.description: Custom generators infinite-loop on invalid size; integer overflow possible

high_findings.title: picomatch & minimatch - Regular Expression DoS (ReDoS)
high_findings.description: Glob pattern matching allows catastrophic backtracking
high_findings.fix: npm update picomatch minimatch to latest

high_findings.title: js-yaml - Arbitrary Code Execution via Unsafe Deserialization
high_findings.description: Default deserialization allows RCE via !!js/object tags; use {safe: true}
high_findings.fix: npm update js-yaml; use safe: true in yaml.load() calls

items: Full dependency audit across all 10 projects

TheGuardians: DEP-002: Vitest LAN-based arbitrary file read/execution
DEP-003: Protobufjs prototype pollution in gRPC messages

recommendations.immediate: Deploy handlebars, vitest, protobufjs updates this week
recommendations.ci_integration: Add npm audit --audit-level=high to CI/CD pipeline
recommendations.monitoring: Quarterly dependency audits; watch list for handlebars, vitest, protobufjs
recommendations.governance: No GPL/AGPL licenses; all MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD compatible
